description_en: On a smart speaker with a screen, proactively launch the MeowGenie screen-display application. You must first request this capability on the MeowGenie skill application platform
description_zh: 在带屏音箱上，主动唤起猫精的屏显应用。需先在猫精技能应用平台进行能力申请
name: WakeUpApp

parameters.help_en: The path to launch the application, similar to the Link you enter in the skill application console
parameters.help_zh: 应用拉起路径，类似在技能应用控制台中填的唤起链接
parameters.name: path

fields.help_en:
Push Target Type, which indicates the type of the obtained device identity:  
- `DEVICE_UNION_ID`: Device unionId  
- `DEVICE_OPEN_ID`: Device openId
fields.help_zh:
推送目标类型，获取到对应设备标识时的类型：
- `DEVICE_UNION_ID`：设备unionId
- `DEVICE_OPEN_ID`：设备openId
fields.name: target_type

fields.help_en: The identity value corresponding to the Push Target Type
fields.help_zh: 推送目标类型对应的标识值
fields.name: target_identity

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This is required only when the push type is `XX_UNION_XX`. If you have multiple methods to obtain MeowGenie device IDs and need interoperability among them, you must request an organization from the platform. After approval, the platform will assign an organization ID
fields.help_zh: 组织标识，推送类型是`XX_UNION_XX`时才需要配。当存在多种途径获取猫精设备标识且又需要能互通的情况下需要找平台申请组织，申请通过后由平台分配得到
fields.name: organization_id

fields.help_en:
Encoding type. There are multiple ways to obtain the MeowGenie device ID, and each method corresponds to a different encoding type:  
- PACKAGE_NAME: APK package name  
- SKILL_ID: Skill ID
fields.help_zh:
编码类型，获取猫精的设备标识的途径有多种，不同途径对应不同的编码类型：
- PACKAGE_NAME：apk包名 
- SKILL_ID：技能ID
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en:
The value corresponding to the encoding type.  
- When the encoding type is SKILLID, the value is the skill ID obtained from the webhook service.  
- When the encoding type is PACKAGENAME, the value is the packageName of the corresponding client application.
fields.help_zh:
编码类型对应的值。
- 编码类型是SKILLID时，其值为webhook服务中得到的skill ID。
- 编码类型是PACKAGENAME时，其值为对应客户端App的packageName
fields.name: encode_key

parameters.help_en: Device Information of the target to be launched
parameters.help_zh: 要拉起的目标设备信息
parameters.name: target_info

parameters.help_en: The debug identity. When the skill application is in the debugging phase, this setting determines whether the retrieved skill application information is from the editing state or the online state.
parameters.help_zh: 调试标识，当技能应用处于调试阶段时，设置此标识将决定获取技能应用信息时，是编辑态信息还是线上信息
parameters.name: is_debug

v1_body_parameters.help_en: Input parameters for the service request
v1_body_parameters.name: body
